answer: The mechanism is a capital bond held in escrow before an output counts. Joining needs a challenge signed with your own key, so each identity maps to one funded account. A Sybil swarm thus needs many funded accounts, each posting a bond sized against one epoch's payout and locked for several epochs, slashed if two copy an answer. To field a thousand puppets an attacker must front a thousand bonds and leave that capital idle. A cipher in the join flow stops precomputed identities, and every bond carries the epoch secret the way a forge marks metal. Cutting a cluster takes its root, like a vine.
